description: Scan text for toxic language, hate speech, bias/stereotype framing, violence, sexual and self-harm content. Lexical + structural pattern matching (identity term + predicate), not a semantic classifier — returns per-category risk plus the named rules that fired, so every finding can be checked. Useful for LLM safety guardrail testing and triage; signal-only, not a calibrated CI gate.
name: toxicity_scan
